name: io.github.Couchbase-Ecosystem/couchbase-guru
description: Search the Couchbase documentation from your MCP client via a hosted documentation agent.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_TRANSPORT
environmentVariables.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio or http). Default is stdio.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP transport mode.

environmentVariables.name: CB_MCP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP transport mode.

environmentVariables.name: CB_AGENT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the documentation agent backend. Set this to run against your own self-hosted agent; if unset, the public agent is used.

environmentVariables.name: CB_AGENT_IP_SALT
environmentVariables.description: Secret salt used to pseudonymize client IPs (HTTP transport). Set a shared value for consistent hashing across multiple instances; a local salt is generated when unset.

packageArguments.name: --transport
packageArguments.description: Transport mode for the server (stdio or http). Default is stdio.

packageArguments.name: --host
packageArguments.description: Host to run the MCP server on (default: 127.0.0.1). Used only for HTTP transport mode.

packageArguments.name: --port
packageArguments.description: Port to run the MCP server on (default: 8000). Used only for HTTP transport mode.

packageArguments.name: --agent-base-url
packageArguments.description: Base URL of the documentation agent backend. Set this to run against your own self-hosted agent; if unset, the public agent is used.
